children: Sandisk entered into Amendment No. 1 to its Loan Agreement, establishing a secured $1.5 billion multi-currency revolving credit facility that refinances its prior revolver. The facility bears interest at Adjusted Term SOFR or Daily Simple SOFR plus a margin starting at 1.375%, or a base rate plus 0.375%, with a 0.175% commitment fee, each subject to leverage- or ratings-based adjustments. The revolver matures on Sep 9, 2031, includes a leverage covenant, and may release collateral and guarantees upon achieving investment-grade corporate family ratings. The borrowing capacity includes U.S. dollars, euros, yen, and other agreed currencies.
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as administrative agent, and other lenders
: Refinance prior revolver and enhance liquidity and financial flexibility
